source_text: In high HIV-prevalence regions of sub-Saharan Africa, three randomized controlled trials demonstrated that adult voluntary medical male circumcision reduces heterosexual HIV acquisition in men by 50-60%, prompting World Health Organization recommendations for scale-up in those settings. [78]
